title: Better pale garden
description: Enhance the Pale Garden Biome with new rewards.
body:
This datapack adds a new mechanic to the game and new rewards that you can get in the pale garden!

# about the pack
<details>
<summary>Mechanic</summary>
There are 4 mechanics in this pack:

**the pale eye.**

During night time, whilst in the pale garden, you will be able to throw the pale eye, which will lead you to a certain spot in the garden.
once it comes in contact with that spot, a portal spawns, spawning loot alongside side it.
such as the: pale eye, pale bark and the new enchantments.

**the pale armor.**

basically fully heals ya once you get hurt (IT DOESN'T PROTECT YOU FROM DEATH), has aa cooldown that you can configure. (look in settings)

## enchantments:
**greed** - an enchant for sword and the pale Macuahuitl, giving xp to the user on each hit. However, it will make the sword deal less damage from falling (basically the opposite of a mace but it doesnt scale).

**wind lift** - an enchant for the mace, not compatible with the wind burst. has 3 levels each one will levitate you higher into the air once you a hit a mob from ground level.
</details>

<details>
<summary>about them</summary>

**Pale eye**

During night time, whilst in the pale garden biome you will be able to throw this eye, which will lead you to a nearby pit, Once in contact (the eye and the pit) a portal will spawn, spawning loot alongside it.

**Pale Macuahuitl**

It's basically a sword, However you can press right click on it will let you take less dmg, at the cost of moving slower. (can be enchanted with normal sword enchantments)

**Pale armor**

(includes all armor pieces)
crafted like a diamond armor, has the same attributes as a diamond armor However it has a special ability which fully heals you (only if you have the full set) once you dont have full hp every some amount of time (on default its 1 min but can be ajusted look at settings) and it is crafted with pale barks.

**Pale bark**

aquired by opening a portal in the pale garden, which has a chance to spawn this item.
this item does nothing except bieng used in crafting recipes

# enchantments:
greed: an enchant for sword and the pale Macuahuitl, giving xp to the user on each hit. However, it will make the sword deal less damage from falling (basically the oppesite of a mace but it doesnt scale).

wind lift: an enchant for the mace, not compatible with the wind burst. has 3 levels each one will levitate you higher into the air once you a hit a mob from ground level.
</details>
</details>
<details>
<summary>settings</summary>
In this pack there are 4 settings that you can change, the cooldown of the healing ability of the armor and if players will get the guide book on the start


```
/data modify storage pale:settings book.givebook set value 1
```
if set to 1, will give the guide book to players.


```
/data modify storage pale:settings armor.cooldown set value 1200
```
will change the cooldown of the heal ability of the **pale armor**


```
/data modify storage pale:settings creaking.domoredmg set value 1
```
will change the dmg that the creaking mob deals based on the dmg value if set to 1

```
/data modify storage pale:settings creaking.dmg set value 1
```
will change the dmg that the creaking mob deals

</details>
